measurement_context: Local dev/build measurements only (localhost, loopback network) -- NOT representative of real-world network latency. Recorded to document payload sizes and structure, per Section 40, ahead of any future deployment-phase performance work.

source_considered.dashboard_grid.geojson_full: 33.9 MB (Phase 12 full presentation export -- NOT used by the frontend)
source_considered.dashboard_grid_lite.geojson: 21.0 MB (Phase 12 lite presentation export -- base for the frontend payload)

map_geometry_payload.geometry_simplification_status: Reused verbatim from Phase 12's dashboard_grid_lite.geojson (20m Douglas-Peucker tolerance, 5-decimal coordinate precision) -- no additional simplification applied. 3 small categorical fields (required_categories_walk_15/cycle_15, cross_app_convergence, data_confidence) were joined on for presentation purposes; this increased size by ~1.6MB.
map_geometry_payload.decision: Used the LITE geometry, per Section 6 instruction to prefer lite geometry if visual quality is adequate -- did not load the heavier 33.9MB full export.

grid_attributes_payload.loading_strategy: Fetched once client-side via a singleton in-memory cache (lib/useGridAttributes.ts) on first Grid Intelligence Card open, shared across all pages for the rest of the session -- not re-fetched per page navigation, not bundled into the initial page load.
grid_attributes_payload.known_limitation: 27MB is a meaningful one-time fetch on a slow connection. Acceptable for a local MVP; a real deployment should consider per-grid lazy fetch (e.g. a small API route keyed by grid_id) instead of one bulk JSON file -- explicitly noted as future work, not implemented here per the Phase 13 scope boundary (no backend unless genuinely required).

build_output.build_status: Compiled successfully; TypeScript type-checked with no errors.

server_response_times_localhost.note: Loopback measurements only, not a proxy for real user latency.

if_performance_is_poor: Per Section 40: any future optimization targets the PRESENTATION data (further geometry simplification, splitting grid_attributes.json by district for lazy loading, or moving it behind a small API route) -- analytical logic and values are never simplified or altered to improve performance.
